strings: Quietly, m_c admits to r_c0 in some ways {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/are/is} relieved that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} intermittent paralysis has progressed to full paralysis.

As {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates keep trying to say it's not so bad and that it could be worse, m_c just wishes they would leave {PRONOUN/m_c/object} alone. It makes no difference to {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to be fully paralyzed.
All m_c can feel is tired at the confirmation that {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} intermittent paralysis has progressed fully.
